statement: Write every parameter name in full, never abbreviated.
why: An abbreviation in a table is undefined at the point of reading.

statement: One physical quantity per row or cell; never two quantities joined by a slash.
why: A packed cell hides which value is which.

statement: Put the unit right after the parameter name, in the bracket style of dimension table.unit-brackets; the value cell holds a bare number, so every dimensional entry states its unit once.
why: A unit in each value cell repeats and can disagree; one bracket style per document.
provenance: writing-style rule 14; user ruling 2026-11-08; merged table.unit-in-name + table.unit-brackets (user review 2026-11-23 P2-G6)
